sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
விரல் மோதிரம் தனைக் காட்டி வைதேகியின்
வினை களைந்த மாருதியே
sections.translit:
viral mOdhiram thanaik kAtti vaidhEgiyin
vinai kaLaindha mAruthiyE
sections.en: Oh, Maruthi, you removed all of the suffering of Mother Sita (Vaidehi) by showing her Rama’s wedding ring.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
எள்ளி நகைத்தே ஆதவனை அள்ளிய அஞ்சனை புத்திரனே
கள்ளத்தனமாய் வால்வலியால் வீமனுக்கு ஞானமருளிய வாயுருவே
அன்றொரு நாள் இளையவன் உயிர் காக்க
குன்றொடு இலை சுமந்தாயல்லவோ
யாழிசை மார்பனை இலங்கை வேந்தனை
ஆழியைப் பிரித்தே உயிர் மாய்த்திட வழி செய்தாயல்லவோ
சூரலில் ஓடமென அலைந்திடும் என் மனம்
உனை பஜிக்க அருள்பாலி என்றதும் இவ்வினை
துரும்பென தூளென அயர்ந்தாயோ நொடியினில் வருவாய்
நங்கநல்லூர் அமர்ந்த நெடியோனே
sections.translit:
eLLi nagaitthE Adhavanai aLLiya anjanai putthiranE
kaLLatthanamAy vAlvaliyAl vImanukku nyAnamaruLiya vAyuruvE
Charanam 1
andRoru nAL iLaiyavan uyir kAkka
kundRodu ilai sumandhAyallavO
yAzhisai mArbanai ilangai vEndhanai
Azhiyaip piritthE uyir mAytthida vazhi seydhAyallavO
Charanam 2
sUralil Odamena alaindhidum en manam
unai bajikka aruLpAli endRadhum ivvinai
thurumbena thULena ayarndhAyO nodiyinil varuvAy
nanganallUr amarndha nediyOnE
sections.en: Anjanai’s son, you sarcastically laughed at the sun and tried to grab  it. As an aged monkey, you crushed Bhima's ego and enlightened him with the strength of your tail. Charanam 1 Did you not carry the mountain with herbs the other day to save the life of Rama’s younger brother Lakshmana? Did you not make a path across the ocean to kill the veena artist and King of Lanka, Ravana? Charanam 2 Even as my mind was struggling like a raft in fierce wind, I collected myself and sought your grace, and worshiped you. Did you think that what I requested was trivial, and did you go to relax? Oh, tall Anchaneya domiciled in Nanganallur, please come quickly and calm my mind. Assure me of your protection.

notes:
This song references many of Anchaneya’s accomplishments. When Ravana kept Sita in the Ashoka forest, Anchaneya appeared and chanted Sri Rama’s name many times. Sita was not convinced that Achaneya was a genuine emissary from Rama. Hanuman showed her Rama’s wedding ring as proof and addressed all her concerns. She was convinced that Rama would come and rescue her. See the following link for details of this episode:
ஶ்ரீமத் வால்மீகி ராமாயணம், ஸுந்தர காண்டம், ஶ்ரீ உ.வே.C.R. ஶ்ரீநிவாஸய்யங்கார் அவர்களால் மொழி பெயர்க்கப்பட்டது, பதிப்பகத்தார்: தி லிட்டில் ப்ளவர் கம்பெனி, சென்னை 600017, திருச்சி 620002, மறு அச்சு 2000, ஸர்க்கம் 36, ஹனுமான் கணையாழியைக் கொடுத்தது, பக்கம் 143 – 147.
The first line of the Anupallavi refers to Hanuman’s childhood prank. Looking at a red  glowing ball in the sky at dawn, he mistook it for fruit. He flew past the clouds and close to the sun and tried to pick it up and swallow it. An agitated Indra, scared of the prospects of a universe without brightness and warmth, threw his weapon,and the young lad fell down, unconscious. For details, see:
ஆஞ்சநேய புராணம், எழுதியவர் கார்த்திகேயன் (எஸ். ராமநாதன்), பதிப்பகத்தார், கிரி டிரேடிங் ஏஜென்ஸி, இரண்டம் மறு பதிப்பு, செப்டம்பர் 1999, பக்கம் 10 – 12.
The second line of the Anupallavi refers to Bhima’s encounter with an aged Hanuman, from the Vana Parva in Mahabharata. Mesmerized by the fragrance of the Saugandhika flower in the air during the Pandavas’ stay in the forest, Draupadi sent Bhima to fetch flowers for her. Bhima saw an old monkey lying in his path. He ordered the monkey to get out of his path immediately. The monkey did not like the arrogance in Bhima’s tone and challenged Bhima to lift his tail to continue his journey. Bhima tried with all his might and could not move the monkey’s tail at all. Then he realized the monkey’s strength and prostrated himself before him. Hanuman then showed his Viswaroopam and blessed Bhima. They embraced once Bhima understood their kinship.
For details, see the above reference, பக்கம்: 412 – 418. Also see:
ஶ்ரீ மஹாபாரத ஸாரம், உரை ஆசிரியர் “அண்ணா”, ஶ்ரீராமகிருஷ்ண மடம், மயிலாப்பூர், சென்னை 600004, ஏப்ரல் 2002, தீர்த்த யாத்திரை, பக்கம் 546 – 552, verses 146.2 – 151.19.
The charanam 1 lines 1 and 2 refer to the following episode in the Ramayana.  Lakshmana was grievously injured by the Brahmastra, shot by Ravana’s son Indrajit. Lakshmana became unconscious. The elderly statesman Jambhavan suggested that a rare Sanjivini herb in the Himalayas was the only cure for this condition and recommended Hanuman immediately fly  to obtain the herb. However, he was not clear as to exactly which herb Hanuman should bring back. Hanuman departed and reached the hilly area, and since he was in doubt as to which herb, he carried the entire mountain back. As soon as an extract of the herbs was instilled, Lakshmana became active as if he just woke after a deep slumber. For details, see:
ஶ்ரீமத் வால்மீகி ராமாயண ஸாரம், உரை ஆசிரியர் “அண்ணா”, ஶ்ரீராமகிருஷ்ண மடம், சென்னை- 4, பக்கம் 752 – 758, verses 73.3 through 74.80.
The charanam line 3 refers to a legend where the arrogant king of Lanka, Ravana, sang Siva Tandava Stotram. According to popular lore, this occurred when he tried to lift Mount Kailash and an annoyed Siva pressed the mountain with his toe. Unable to bear the pressure, and with his ego battered, Ravana tore his chest and used the exposed nerves as the strings of a veena and rendered Siva Tandava Stotram. Hence the usage of words in line 3 of the charanam,
“யாழிசை மார்பனை இலங்கை வேந்தனை
yAzhisai mArbanai ilangai vEndhanai” .
